nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle
==========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Global GPU/CPU backend toggle for the nvitk GUI.

   Uses the same backend selection as CLI entry points
   (:func:`~nvitk.core.click_backend.apply_cli_backend` / ``--backend cpu|gpu``).



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle.backend_label
   nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle.set_gui_backend
   nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle.set_gpu_backend
   nvitk.gui.tools.gpu_toggle.build_gpu_toggle_button


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: backend_label() -> str

   Human-readable label for the active global backend.


.. py:function:: set_gui_backend(backend: str, *, log: bool = True) -> nvitk.core.backend.BackendName

   Set process-wide backend from ``cpu`` / ``gpu`` (same as ``nvitk-gui --backend``).


.. py:function:: set_gpu_backend(enabled: bool, *, log: bool = True) -> nvitk.core.backend.BackendName

   Toggle GPU on/off via :func:`set_gui_backend` (``gpu`` / ``cpu``).


.. py:function:: build_gpu_toggle_button(*, on_changed: Callable[[], None] | None = None)

   Checkable button that toggles the global nvitk backend.
